messages:
Ava (Partnerships Ops): Heads-up: we're running a full dry-run next Tuesday for the marketplace launch - objective: end-to-end simulcast (listing + press + partner microsite) and SI handoff rehearsal. Need confirmations on timing, assets, and who will run each station.
Tom (PR): I'm available. We'll rehearse embargo lift + press outreach cadence. Proposal: embargo lift Tue 08:00 PT, staggered pickup at 08:05 (partner blog), 08:10 (company blog), 08:15 (press release distribution).
Ellen (Design): Will supply hero banners + adaptive assets. Need final partner logos (SVG/PNG), 2x variants (white/colored), and a 1-line partner tagline. Please send by Mon 10:00 PT.
Rishabh (Platform): Platform checklist: staging listing published, billing SKU wired, marketplace rev-id created, and test tenant provisioned. I can flip the staging listing to published at 07:30 PT for smoke tests. Who can confirm SKU and price?
Nora (Sales): Sales asks for one-pager + CTAs that route leads into partner SDR queue. Also want to confirm free-trial allowance for marketplace signups (30 seat-days?) - need billing SKU mapping.
Kai (Partner Eng): From partner side: TerraCompute will provide a validation unit Tuesday morning; BlueWave SI needs sandbox credentials and a pre-run enablement packet. I need sandbox keys + a short runbook for onboarding by Monday EOD.
Ava (Partnerships Ops): Actionable timeline: Mon 09:00 - final logos & quotes; Mon 17:00 - assets in staging; Tue 07:30 - smoke publish on staging; Tue 08:00 - embargo lift (live); Tue 09:00 - post-mortem sync. If any timing conflicts, flag now.
Tom (PR): I'll draft the partner co-blog + press pitch. Need partner spokesperson name and a 2-3 sentence quote. Draft ready Mon noon for review.
Ellen (Design): Quick note: Microlanding should include an explainer gif (30s loop) showing hosted -> dedicated -> private flow. Can someone produce the sequence (screens + arrows)? Prefer product to give content by Mon 11:00.
Rishabh (Platform): SKU: propose "marketplace-basic-1" mapped to trial allowance. Nora confirm. I'll add the marketplace metadata: partner_id=terra-001, partner_cta=book-demo. Also provisioning test tenant redwood-market-test.
Nora (Sales): Confirmed on trial allowance: 30 seat-days is fine for partner-led trials. I'll coordinate SDR routing and provide the webhook for lead ingestion by Mon EOD.
Kai (Partner Eng): For HSM/KMS handshake: TerraCompute requires our key policy reviewed. @Rishabh can you share the minimal key policy and endpoint? We'll need a contact for the KMS exchange.
Rishabh (Platform): Sharing minimal policy in 10. Endpoint: kms-staging.redwood.ai. I'll DM the contact details to Kai. Also note: sandbox keys will be rate-limited to 2qps and 100k tokens/day for the rehearsal.
deploy-bot: Staging update: partners microlanding pushed to staging with preview link https://staging.redwood.ai/partners/terracompute-preview - build: success. Remember to not expose real keys in staging logs.
Ava (Partnerships Ops): Legal check: do we have NDA/co-marketing signed for both partners? If not, please escalate to Legal. We cannot publish partner logos without signed usage.
Tom (PR): I'll ping partners for signoff on the quote + logo usage now. If we don't get it by Mon 10:00, we'll swap with generic partner copy and mark the partner as "listed with permission pending" in internal notes.
Ellen (Design): Small ask: provide 16:9, 4:3, and square crops for hero assets. Also need footer badge for marketplace partner that fits 120x40.
Rishabh (Platform): I'll run a preflight playbook Tue 06:45 PT to validate staging config, CORS, CTA tracking params, and pixel firing. If any check fails, I'll rollback publish.
Nora (Sales): For the webinar: BlueWave wants an SI enablement session on Thu 11:00 PT. Can Product/CS host a 30m module focusing on ramping enterprise customers?
Kai (Partner Eng): Copy that. We'll expect an enablement slide deck and a short runbook for provisioning dedicated capacity. Please deliver by Wed noon.
Ava (Partnerships Ops): Summarize owners: PR: Tom, Design: Ellen, Platform: Rishabh, Sales enablement: Nora, Partner Eng liaison: Kai, Partnerships coordination: Ava. I'll make a short playbook and calendar invites. Everyone please react with :white_check_mark: once you've blocked time.
Tom (PR): :white_check_mark:
Ellen (Design): :white_check_mark: (design blocked Mon morning)
Rishabh (Platform): :white_check_mark: (preflight scheduled)
Nora (Sales): :white_check_mark:
Kai (Partner Eng): :white_check_mark:
Ava (Partnerships Ops): Thanks — will post the Asana board and attach the rehearsal checklist. See you Tue 07:30 PT for the staging smoke.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal reminder posted 30m before start in #partnerships and #eng-oncall.
